_readme: E2e regression chain (T-15.3; extended through stage 5 for the outer quality loop, T-40). Stages run in order per video; claude-text stages run under the machine owner's `claude` login and skip loudly if it is absent. Prompts resolve against the build's prompts/ at head — a version bump changes the hash, which is exactly what a regression run is for; chain_run warns when a newer version file exists than the one pinned here. Brand enters via this run-config (rule 7: machinery stays brand-agnostic; the config names the brand at run time). Var syntax: '=literal' · '@stageN' prior stage · '@stageN#pick' its derived pick · '@stageN*' every group video's output concatenated · '#video_count' · anything else = workspace-relative path. Stage 4b's human hook pick has no human in a regression run: 'pick': 'control' takes VERSION 0 and records the deviation in the run manifest. Stage 4e carries 'role': 'judge' — it runs and records, it gates nothing (green is human-calibrated only). Stage 5 carries 'scope': 'group' — a fan-in: one brief per brief_groups entry, which is what the outer e2e loop judges. drive_id is the Drive file id of the source video — the id only, never the media (workspace rule 3). Viewers embed it the way the blind-cal app does: drive.google.com/file/d/<id>/preview.

stages.note: Who our version speaks to. Runs AFTER the breakdown because a video has to be torn down before anyone can say who it speaks to — the copy chain can decide this at triage only because its source is already words. Before stage 2 because the spec is deliberately brand-free, and before stage 3 because injection is the first consumer and a stage cannot choose its own inputs.

RESTORED 2026-08-19 (the owner), after being removed the same day. The chain needs a gate before a brief is written on top of a drifted script. Two known defects it still carries: it has never run, and its SHIP condition passes a script with slots flagged-not-filled — so as written it approves rather than holds (audit finding 1). Fix both or the gate is decorative.

vars.creator_profile: =UNASSIGNED. The run supplies this when it is a creator's own post. Never name a creator here.

stages.note: stage0's triage ruling reaches the brief here. Without this wiring the SOUND FORM line dies at triage and a sung source produces a spoken brief — exactly what happened on swipe-brand-c-song-160986941 (2026-09-02).

stages.why: Stage 5 requires a frame on every scene but is a text pass and cannot cut a still or run an image model, so the brief shipped with none. This stage does it: her own video first, generation only for what it lacks, every frame recorded unchecked. product_look is empty until the product file describes the product — while it is empty, scenes holding the product are skipped rather than generated with invented packaging.

brief_groups.why: The faithful artifact: stage 5 is a fan-in — several source formats become ONE creator brief, which is what actually leaves the building and what the owner's hand-made briefs are. A second brief is one entry here (another creator profile, or a subset of videos) — grouping is a config line, not a code change.

known_deviations: source formats are creator-g's videos while the creator profile is Creator F's — stage 5's rule 'name which of HER OWN posts the structure came from' cannot be satisfied by this fixture set, and the 2026-08-17 run fabricated a citation at exactly this point. Judge that section knowing the input made it unanswerable.
